question: Do different subjects share the same intrinsic perception->imagery transformation STRUCTURE even when their neural coordinate systems/orientations are subject-specific? (SHARED LAW / PRIVATE COORDINATES -- conceptual, not physical gauge symmetry)
critical_distinction: not T_s~=T_d in native coords (O2.10 addressed that); instead I(T_s)~=I(T_d) where I is a frozen vector of basis-invariant quantities
immutable_o2: ALL O2.8-O2.16 + O2.16-DATA/-AUTH seals + historical executive scientific statuses UNCHANGED; O2.16 remains blocked awaiting independent cohort; X1 cannot unlock O3; O3_NOT_READY
representation: reuse ONLY certified O2 representations per subject/ROI/fold: frozen W_target, target-native imagery residual delta_native (10 outer-training identities), within/outside components, full-resource geometry; NO new ROI/voxel-selection/rank/D/alignment/Procrustes/hyperparameter
coordinate_invariance: all invariants computed in native voxel space and invariant to (a) orthogonal rotation of W_target columns, (b) singular/eigenvector sign flips, (c) identity ordering; verified <=1e-10

A_SPECTRAL_SHAPE.on: within-support coordinate matrix Z = delta_native @ W_target (10 x K); top r_best spectrum

B_PRINCIPAL_ANGLES.between: perception support col(W_target) (K) and raw imagery support = top-(r_best+2) left-singular subspace of delta_native (NOT the within/outside split, to avoid pipeline-trivial 0/90 angles)
B_PRINCIPAL_ANGLES.common_rank: r_common = min frozen eligible rank across 8 subjects for that ROI

features: frac target-state energy within perception support

D_COMPRESSION.on: full imagery operator delta_native (10 x V) spectrum

no_feature_shopping: primary invariant vector = ONLY the frozen features above; NO post-outcome skewness/kurtosis/arbitrary ratios/graph/nonlinear/learned/handcrafted stats; exploratory extras only in a quarantined appendix AFTER primary seal
dimension_matching: for rank-indexed spectral comparisons use r_common = min frozen eligible rank across 8 subjects (per ROI); report rank separately; no zero-padding beyond native support

subject_signature.build: per subject x ROI: compute each invariant per outer fold -> average fold-wise -> concatenate ONLY frozen components; standardize with DONOR-ONLY stats in LOSO

hypothesis_A_dispersion.D_obs: median pairwise Euclidean distance after component-wise normalization defined WITHOUT outcome tuning

matched_null_B_label.type: subject-spectrum label null: preserve empirical subject spectra, independently permute subject labels across the 4 blocks
matched_null_B_label.purpose: test that blocks form a reproducible SUBJECT-level signature, not cohort-average summaries

hypothesis_B_loso.predictor: donor-mean only: I_pred_s = mean_{d!=s} I_d (NO regression/NN/weights/hyperparameters)
hypothesis_B_loso.E_SHARED_s: mean_null ||I_null_target - I_pred|| - ||I_target - I_pred|| (positive => donor-consensus predicts the real target better than matched-null targets)

null_for_loso.type: permute invariant dimensions within prospectively-defined exchangeable blocks preserving marginal values + block size + target norm

matched_null_A_svrand.type: singular-vector randomization: preserve per-subject singular values/rank/energy/perception-support dim, destroy shared correspondence via deterministic random orthogonal rotations
matched_null_A_svrand.note: a null preserving singular values cannot test shared spectra -> not used for spectral blocks

primary_inference.family: 4 invariant blocks x 2 primary ROIs = EXACTLY 8 tests

support_rule: SHARED_INVARIANT_STRUCTURE_SUPPORTED (block x ROI) iff ALL: median E_SHARED>0; >=6/8 E_SHARED>0; Holm reject; donor-mean prediction beats matched null for the participant median (no arbitrary effect-size threshold)

secondary_orientation_synthesis.reuse_o2_10_immutable: historical direct-orientation-transfer FAIL; DO NOT rerun O2.10 with modified estimators
secondary_orientation_synthesis.table: per ROI: DIRECT_ORIENTATION_TRANSFER (O2.10 status) vs INVARIANT_STRUCTURE (X1 status)

subject_identifiability.method: leave-one-fold-out: match target-fold orientation against each subject's remaining-fold orientation signature

basis_rotation_invariance.apply: arbitrary deterministic orthogonal basis rotations preserving the operator/subspace equivalence class

require_invariance_to: basis-column permutation where the statistic is unordered

negative_control_random_ops.generate: matched random operators preserving subject rank + total energy + support sizes
negative_control_random_ops.expect: invariant profiles do NOT show the complete X1 pattern unless the statistic is trivially determined by the preserved quantity

pipeline_triviality.per_positive_invariant: quantify between-subject variance; if the synthetic constrained null shows essentially identical between-subject dispersion -> mark PIPELINE_CONSTRAINED_INVARIANT

fold_robustness.per_supported_invariant: leave-one-outer-fold-out re-estimation; LOFO_STABLE iff participant-level E_SHARED sign remains positive for >=6/8 subjects under every fold omission

program_status.SHARED_INTRINSIC_TRANSFORMATION_STRUCTUR: >=2 distinct invariant blocks supported in BOTH primary ROIs
program_status.SHARED_INTRINSIC_STRUCTURE_PRIVATE_ORIEN: above passes AND historical O2.10 direct orientation transfer remains negative (PREFERRED when conditions met)
program_status.INVARIANT_STRUCTURE_MULTIREGIME: supported blocks differ materially between primary ROIs
program_status.NO_REPRODUCIBLE_SHARED_INTRINSIC_STRUCTU: no invariant block supported in either ROI

claim_boundaries.positive_allowed: despite failure of direct cross-subject target-state orientation transfer, multiple coordinate-invariant properties of the perception-to-imagery transformation were reproducible across subjects, consistent with shared intrinsic transformation structure expressed in subject-specific neural coordinates
claim_boundaries.gauge_invariant_means: mathematical shorthand for tested basis-invariant quantities only

synthetic_controls: 1 identical spectrum/random orientation -> invariant PASS, orientation transfer FAIL
2 different spectra/matched orientation -> spectral invariant FAIL
4 orthogonal basis rotations leave invariants unchanged

next_gate.SHARED_INTRINSIC_STRUCTURE_PRIVATE_ORIEN: X1.1 MINIMAL CANONICAL FORM OF THE SHARED TRANSFORMATION (which invariants are necessary to characterize the common equivalence class; no new predictive model yet)
next_gate.negative: seal negative; do NOT search additional invariants on the same cohort and call them confirmatory
